description: Sama RAN simulator is provided by Sama project. Sama is a Python radio-access-network simulator supporting uplink and downlink between spatially distributed users and base stations. It uses channel-state information to represent link capacity and resource allocation. Geographic context: global. Temporal coverage and spatial resolution are not established beyond the source details stated here. Source code and documentation are linked through the public repository; no software was installed or executed. The cited material was readable without payment.
